title: Bulls and Cows
tagline: Crack the secret code. Hints that teach.
description: The classic code-breaking game on lit enamel pegs. Guess the secret digits and read the clues: bulls are right digit, right place; cows are right digit, wrong place. Break the computer's code or set your own, with a daily code, hints that explain the logic and Watch and Learn.
howToPlay: Guess the hidden code by tapping digit pegs, then tap Guess.
Gold bulls: right digit, right place. Teal cows: right digit, wrong place.
Use the clues to rule digits in and out and crack the code in few guesses.
Set the Code lets you hide a secret and score the computer's guesses.
Tap the bulb for a hint that explains why; Watch and Learn shows a full game.
